thread:
Emma: Heads up — VoltCloud flagged invoice mismatch after last week's marketplace listing. Their seats SKU mapped to our 'embed_units' in billing which doubled charges for some accounts. Ticket: https://volt.support/PL-778
Raj: can you paste the sample invoice ID?
Emma: Volt-invoice-9981 pasted (redacted): shows sku=volt_seat_v2 -> charge = 2000 embed_units instead of seat_units
Nina: sounds like SKU mapping in the marketplace contract didn’t include the new seat_v2 tag. Our ingestion maps by partner_sku -> internal_product_id.
Raj: quick fix: add a temporary mapping rule for partner=voltcloud AND sku startswith 'volt_seat' -> product=seat_units. That will fix invoicing without altering historic data.
Emma: agree. but we also need to notify affected customers and offer credit. billing-bot: run query to get affected customer list for last 30 days.
billing-bot: Query queued: SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM marketplace_usage WHERE partner='voltcloud' AND sku LIKE 'volt_seat%' AND billed_product='embed_units' AND usage_date >= '2026-02-10'; estimated rows: 54
Nina: ops note: make the mapping change as a feature flag behind partnerships.hotfix.volt_sku_map so we can rollback.
Raj: I'll push the mapping hotfix and schedule a dry-run to the staging ledger. ETA 2h.
Emma: communications: I'll draft an email with subject "Billing correction for VoltCloud seat SKU" and include steps to request credit if customers were impacted. Nina please review.
Nina: will review. also let's add a contract-side check: for marketplace listings we should require explicit SKU->product mapping in initial onboarding checklist.
ops-bot: automated: hotfix deployment planned at 2026-03-03T16:30:00Z to canary region us-west-2. Monitoring alert: increase in post-hotfix invoice anomalies will trigger P0.
Raj: deployed mapping to canary. running validation: comparing total seat_units consumed vs pre-fix last 30 days.
billing-bot: Validation: pre-fix seat_units sum=12,340; post-fix projected seat_units sum=12,312; diff= -28 (expected rounding). no large anomalies.
Emma: great. action items: Raj implement feature-flagged mapping, Nina add onboarding checklist item, Emma send partner & customer comms, billing-bot prepare credits queue. We'll reconvene 24h after full rollout. :thumbsup:
